reference_sql:
SELECT pu.product_id, pu.units
FROM (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, category_name, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY product_id, category_name
) AS pu
JOIN (
  -- one row per category
  SELECT x.category_name, AVG(x.units) AS avg_units
  FROM (
    -- one row per product
    SELECT product_id, category_name, SUM(units) AS units
    FROM sales
    GROUP BY product_id, category_name
  ) AS x
  GROUP BY x.category_name
) AS ca ON ca.category_name = pu.category_name
WHERE pu.units > ca.avg_units
alternatives:
WITH product_units AS (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, category_name, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY product_id, category_name
)
SELECT pu.product_id, pu.units
FROM product_units pu
WHERE pu.units > (
  SELECT AVG(pu2.units)
  FROM product_units pu2
  WHERE pu2.category_name = pu.category_name
)

WITH product_units AS (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, category_name, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY product_id, category_name
),
category_avg AS (
  -- one row per category
  SELECT category_name, AVG(units) AS avg_units
  FROM product_units
  GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT pu.product_id, pu.units
FROM product_units pu
JOIN category_avg ca ON ca.category_name = pu.category_name
WHERE pu.units > ca.avg_units

WITH product_units AS (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, category_name, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY product_id, category_name
)
SELECT pu.product_id, pu.units

WHERE pu.units > (
  SELECT AVG(pu2.units)
  FROM product_units pu2
  WHERE pu2.category_name = pu.category_name
)
other_way.tradeoff: One WITH step read twice replaces two copies of the same derived table, so the product totals are written only once.

solver.query:
WITH pu AS (SELECT ol.product_id, p.category_id, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM order_lines ol JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id GROUP BY ol.product_id, p.category_id)
SELECT product_id, units FROM pu WHERE units > (SELECT AVG(x.units) FROM pu x WHERE x.category_id = pu.category_id)
